r.notes: Koalas were first seen wrestling on the ground
Had left red ear tag and was first seen fighting with another koala on the ground
Many people walk dogs here- be great to have some signs saying “koalas sighted here” so they would be careful when walking
Had a male koala chasing her around the tree
He was trying to mate with a female who was in same tree
Reported to KAG via local councillor
It roamed around the yard then crossed the road twice and eventually went up a neighbour's roadside tree
It has been around for a week or so
Koala was bellowing from a tree on the Birkdale golf course
First one seen for many months
Redlands A/hour Wildlife Ambulance called to pick the koala up for transportation to Aust Zoo Wildlife Hospital
Reported to KAG phone,  F&Y nearby reported separately.
Reported to KAG phone.  Caller has  seen Ks resting in sheoaks
The same male has been around here for many years approx. 5.
Male koala in stringy bark (gender assumed from grunting heard during the night)
The Kola's left eye appeared to be damaged i.e. opaque looking.
Healthy adult in a Brushbox tree.

Healthy looking, on the ground, crossing the yard. Ended up in tree near the house where it stayed all day. Looked like female (white chest as far as I could see) but we heard grunting at night (grunting only, no mating) so it might have been a male after all.
Did not actually see it but heard male koala grunting close to our home
